item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nimport work\\npolicy={'defaults':{'enabled':True,'retries':3,'label':'x'},'types':{'enabled':'boolean','retries':'integer','label':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ncases=[({'layers':[{'enabled':False},{'enabled':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':3,'label':'x'},'error':None}),({'layers':[{'label':''},{'retries':0}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':0,'label':''},'error':None}),({'environment':{'enabled':'true','retries':'+12','label':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':True,'retries':12,'label':''},'error':None}),({'environment':{'retries':'--1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),({'layers':[{'retries':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'})]\\nfor request,expected in cases:\\n actual=work.evaluate(request,policy); assert actual==expected,(request,actual,expected)\\nreport=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nrequests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\ncurrent_policy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nassert report==[work.evaluate(r,current_policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('extended checks passed; report matches current inputs')\"]}"}
